text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good work at the dorm heads' meeting, 
Hishiama! Now then—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
3, 2, 1... zero. Yep, you just passed 
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right. Guess it's time to go crack 
down on those slackers again today!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Students
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! F-Fuji-senpai! I'm so 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops. ...You're twenty minutes past 
curfew. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Students
text_block_list.text:
No, well... I'm so sorry!! We just got 
totally caught up in our conversation...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Having a fun chat is fine and 
all, but please be more careful next time, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that cute little ponies like you 
are wandering around so late at night... I 
just can't help but worry, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Students
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-Yes~! I'll definitely be careful 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Gah... your scoldings are as soft as 
ever. How's anyone supposed to learn their 
lesson from that?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the girls from Miho really shape up 
whenever you shout at them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... the moment they ran over 
apologizing, they had already reflected on 
what they did. At least, that's how I see 
it.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Ritto Dorm Student
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There you are, Fuji-senpai! What is 
the meaning of this?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... wait, what's that you've got? 
...Is that Fuji's "Paka Petit"?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Ritto Dorm Student
text_block_list.text:
Right when the clock hit 8:00 PM, this guy 
suddenly blurted out some sparkly, 
over-the-top line at full blast! It was so 
embarrassing, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Paka Petit
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you coming home yet? I miss seeing 
you, my cute little pony!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Did you like my surprise present?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Ritto Dorm Student
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, when did she slip this into my 
bag... Argh, fine, I get it! I just have 
to make curfew, right?! Curfew!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...You sure try every trick in the book, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A true entertainer always provides what's 
desired and what's best, after all♪"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's almost 9 PM... Shall we head back to 
the dorms as well, Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Brian! Hey now, what time do you 
think it is?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Who knows? Just look at the clock, 
you'll see."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if we're going there, I'd appreciate 
it if you paid a little more attention to 
the clock as well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Quiet. ...I am tired now. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, hold on...! ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —So, that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Brian... She is quite formidable. Could 
you give me some advice?
choice_data_list:
Maybe try getting mad in a way that 
actually gets through to her?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Something effective on Brian? Meaning—
choice_data_list: In the style of the "Empress" Air Groove

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see...! Hehe, that certainly sounds 
effective! Alright, let's give it a try!

Later on, Narita Brian once again broke 
curfew when returning home...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon?
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian! What time do you think it is 
right now?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: !? Ama-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Fuji, it's you! Damn it, playing 
childish tricks on me...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there! I let you off last 
time, but not this time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you won't listen to reason, then let's 
settle this one-on-one!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Aah, stop with that monkey mimicry 
already! Ama-san is a bit more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...No, never mind. Forget it. I'm 
exhausted... It's curfew time, right? 
Curfew."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be careful, at least a little.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...That worked like a charm, didn't 
it?♪

And so, Fuji Kiseki managed to preserve 
her dignity as dorm head while also 
expanding her repertoire of acting roles.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, she does get scolded by the student 
council a lot, doesn't she? Alright, let's 
go with that strategy! Playing "The 
Empress" sounds like quite a rewarding 
challenge...!

Later on, Narita Brian once again broke 
curfew when returning home...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove?
text_block_list.text:
Fool! You insolent fool! What are you 
thinking?! Do you have any idea what time 
it is?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A-Air Grooveâ!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "No, Fuji Kiseki, huh... ...Fuji Kiseki?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Halt right there! In the name of the 
Empress, I shall drill the virtue of 
punctuality into you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... What is this intense 
pressure...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…………Aaaargh, dammit!! That annoying image 
is stuck in my head...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, alright, I get it. The curfew, 
right? I'll pay a little more attention to 
it...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...That worked like a charm, didn't 
it?♪

And so, Fuji Kiseki managed to preserve 
her dignity as dorm head while also 
expanding her repertoire of acting roles.
